Page 2: example 12-8=4 (count up 4 hops: 9, 10, 11, 12); 14-11=3, 15-13=2, 11-7=4. Page 3: example 13-3=10; 15-5=10, 12-2=10, 14-4=10. Page 4: example 13-4=13-3-1=10-1=9 (first take 3 crossed out, second take 1 circled, 9 dots left); 12-5=12-2-3=10-3=7, 15-7=15-5-2=10-2=8. Page 5: example 7+6=13, 13-6=7, 13-7=6; 9+4=13 with 13-4=9 and 13-9=4; 8+6=14 with 14-6=8 and 14-8=6; 15-9=6 (think 9+6=15), 12-7=5 (think 7+5=12). Page 6: 14-3=11, 13-11=2, 16-8=8, 12-5=7, 15-9=6, 11-4=7; any strategy the child can show or explain that gives the correct difference is accepted.
pack: Grade 1 Math: Subtraction Fact Strategies Within 20

pages_detail.activities: One worked number-line example (13-4=9, start at the circled 13, hop back to 12, 11, 10, 9); three problems where children draw their own backward hops from the pre-circled big number
pages_detail.title: Count Back

pages_detail.activities: One worked number-line example (12-8=4, start at the circled 8, count up 4 hops: 9, 10, 11, 12); one dot-row comparison (14 against 11); two number-line problems starting from the small number
pages_detail.title: Count Up to Find the Difference

pages_detail.activities: One worked Before/After ten-frame example (13-3=10: take the 3 extra ones, the ten stands); three problems with a single blank each, each landing on 10
pages_detail.title: First, Get to 10

pages_detail.activities: Numbered three-step worked example (13-4=13-3-1=9: step 1 first take to 10, step 2 one more from the ten, step 3 the 9 remaining dots on their own); two practice problems with stepped equation blanks and both take marks distinguished (plain X for the first take, circled X for the second take)
pages_detail.title: Reach 10, Then Take the Rest

pages_detail.activities: Worked fact-family triangle (7+6=13 with 13-6=7 and 13-7=6); two complete-the-family problems; two think-addition problems
pages_detail.title: Use Addition to Subtract

pages_detail.activities: Six problems; for each, circle one of four outlined strategy choices (Count Back, Count Up, Make 10, Use Addition) and solve in a spacious answer box; rows separated by subtle lines
answers: Any strategy the child can show or explain that gives the correct difference is right
pages_detail.title: Pick Your Strategy
